name: godagent
description: GODAgent — a faithful recreation of the Grok Bot experience (persistent AI teammates with avatars, memory, computer, routines, skills).

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix web run dev" "npm --prefix server run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run test && npm --prefix web run test:e2e
